purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The Chief Surveyor General identifies its spatial component as a computerized map of land parcels and administrative boundaries across South Africa. Official government ArcGIS metadata identifies a nationwide polygon layer named Erven, with geometry and non-owner parcel-reference fields. A point query at the unchanged Gqeberha WUP locator did not complete before the transport timeout, so no sample or point coverage is claimed.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Chief Surveyor General data page describes the national spatial component as a computerised map of land parcels and administrative boundaries; search result identifies data contacts/downloads.

Exact unchanged-WUP-point query was attempted with only safe parcel key/reference fields plus full geometry; client timed out before HTTP status, so no point result is claimed.
Municipal valuation site confirms Nelson Mandela Bay property roll exists; it is owner/property-owner-oriented and was not queried for parcel data.
